candidates.constant: Train labeled prevalence; unchanged on later splits

preprocessing: Train-only median imputation with missing indicators; train-only scaling for logistic regression

calibration.raw_predictions: diagnostic only; cannot replace calibrated candidate after validation

selection: Highest calibrated validation AP; exact ties choose logistic regression; no parameter search

alert_policy.method: Monthly top fraction; deterministic tie handling using private loan key
alert_policy.purpose: Research capacity simulation; not a lender requirement

uncertainty.method: Paired bootstrap by loan, preserving all loan-months

support_limit: Support minima are research guardrails, not a power calculation or business validity guarantee
test_opening: Vintage2022 performance/origination members are opened only once after locked candidate passes recomputed validation; vintage2020 is consumed and unsupported. ZIP directory metadata and whole-archive hashes do not inspect records.
service_acceptance: Separate immutable bundle, parity, access, load, monitoring and rollback evidence; never automatic promotion
development_basis: Audited past-history candidates; reuse 2018 train to isolate bounded research, use newer vintage2021 for disjoint 2023 calibration and 2024 validation. Vintage2022 is the latest supplied cohort and is wholly sealed until conditional one-shot test. Years/windows chosen from origination year and official March2026 cutoff before any new outcome inspection.
previous_development_data_used: V1/v2 validation calendar 2020 used for development; not independent evidence. Later 2019 sample windows are development validation too; no virgin validation claim.
history_contract: Exact prior calendar months; incomplete delinquency windows NULL with completeness indicators; recency NULL means no known event and must be interpreted with completeness; UPB stock change is not a payment.
authorization_basis: Owner delegated bounded technical research decisions and requested continuation with supplied 2021/2022 archives; private retrospective scope and previously accepted source terms. Not an owner-signed hash or fintech/public scoring authorization.
